identified_issues: Violation of Fail-Closed Defensive Design due to executing an automatic retry during an unverified timeout state

evidence: Single scalar telemetry error log: '[2026-10-05T14:22:01Z] PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ADAPTER_ERR: CODE 504_TIMEOUT (duration: 30000ms)'

Payment gateway architecture document confirms CODE 504_TIMEOUT is emitted identically under mutually incompatible failure modes: Condition X (Upstream Bank Outage, DO NOT RETRY) and Condition Y (Ingress Network Drop, SAFE TO RETRY)
